Bourekas

1 pound ground corn beef

1/2 cup chopped onion

1 can cream of celery soup

1 can tomato soup

1/2 cup bread crumbs

1/3 cup grated Swiss cheese

1 teaspoon dried parsley

1 teaspoon dried oregano

1 teaspoon salt

1/4 teaspoon ground pepper

dash capers

1 egg

2 tablespoons oil

hot water

1. In a large bowl combine the corn beef, onion, soup, bread crumbs, cheese, parsley, oregano, salt, pepper, and capers. Mix well.
